$comment: Place table for the gazetteer (T032): official districts (S17) and wards (S40) plus H3 analysis cells. A place keeps every boundary version it has had. Built by src/atlas/spatial/places.py.

fields.name: place_id
fields.meaning: Namespaced source ID: gb-IND-ADM2-<shapeID>, gba2025-c<corp>-w<ward>, or h3:<res>:<index>

fields.name: kind
fields.meaning: state, district, ward or h3; H3 cells are never wards

fields.name: name
fields.meaning: Official name; H3 cells get 'H3 cell r<res> <index>'

fields.name: boundary_version
fields.meaning: Release of the boundary; H3 cells: h3-v4-r<res>|<parent version>

crosswalk: src/atlas/spatial/crosswalk.py: area weights in m2 (EPSG:6933) and population weights from WorldPop cell centres
gazetteer: Local name search only; queries are not stored; no remote geocoder and no autocomplete; more than one match needs a user selection
